changes.now: Fury rallies the team with the cards from Coulson's jacket.
changes.proposed: Fury rallies the team with Coulson's cards.
changes.evidence: In The Avengers (2012), Fury only claims the cards were in Coulson's jacket; Maria Hill then tells him: "those cards-- They were in Coulson's locker. Not in his jacket." Fury: "They needed the push." The egg name (Fury's claim) stays; the hint states the jacket as fact.

owner_calls.now: The Collector keeps the cube in a case.
owner_calls.issue: In the MCU the Collector never held the Tesseract: it was in Odin's Vault, and the Asgardians gave the Collector the Aether (Reality Stone) precisely so two stones were not kept together. The app's Collection is styled as the Collector's archive, so this may be deliberate in-app fiction. If the owner wants it MCU-true, one option: "The cube is on display in the Collection."
